# Entity Resolution

> A practical guide to entity resolution (record linkage, deduplication, data matching, identity resolution), plus a curated list of open-source entity resolution software, datasets, papers, books and tutorials. Maintained by Sonal Goyal, creator of Zingg.

## Guide
- [What is entity resolution?](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/what-is-entity-resolution.html): definition, the five-step pipeline (prepare, block, compare, classify, cluster), use cases
- [Blocking](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/blocking.html): techniques for avoiding n-squared comparisons, learned vs. hand-written blocking
- [Matching approaches](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/matching-approaches.html): deterministic, probabilistic (Fellegi-Sunter), machine learning, deep learning, LLMs
- [Active learning](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/active-learning.html): building training data from a few dozen labelled pairs
- [Evaluating entity resolution](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/evaluating-entity-resolution.html): pairwise and cluster metrics, common mistakes
- [Entity resolution vs. MDM vs. identity resolution](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/entity-resolution-vs-mdm.html)
- [Glossary](https://sonalgoyal.github.io/entity-resolution/docs/glossary.html)

## Tools and resources
- [Awesome entity resolution list and tool comparison](https://github.com/sonalgoyal/entity-resolution#readme): open-source tools (Zingg, Splink, dedupe, Python Record Linkage Toolkit, pyJedAI, fastLink and more), datasets, papers and books
